title: Independent (Sovereign) AI Foundation Model Project
summary: MSIT programme to develop Korean AI foundation models built from scratch, in line with a sovereign-AI goal. On 5 August 2025 MSIT selected five elite teams (Naver Cloud, Upstage, SK Telecom, NC AI and LG AI Research) from 15 applicants; the government supports teams with leased GPU compute. Teams are cut at staged evaluations that combine benchmark, expert and user scores. After the second-stage evaluation announced in August 2026, Upstage, SK Telecom and LG AI Research advanced and Motif Technologies was eliminated. MSIT said the third-stage plan and budget were still being finalised.
